data.exact_reserve_text: The back years, 2018 and prior, contributed GBP 20.6m to the annual result, following better than expected reserve utilisation in the calendar year. In 2021, there has been an overall net (deficit) / surplus in ultimate claims of GBP (8.7m) (2020: GBP 6.0m) due to (higher) / lower than expected incurred movements across most classes of business.

data.standardized_narrative: At the 2021 year end Syndicate 2791 opened the year with gross claims outstanding of GBP 355.5m. During 2021 the syndicate experienced favourable development on older years overall, with the managing agent noting that the 'back years, 2018 and prior, contributed GBP 20.6m to the annual result' (a net release). This net favourable development is principally attributed to favourable claims development / better-than-expected reserve utilisation across several prior years. The year also saw material current-year catastrophe activity (notably Winterstorm Uri and Hurricane Ida) which drove gross incurred claims in 2021, though outwards reinsurance is expected to materially limit net impact. The syndicate reports specific prior-year releases in casualty and Irish motor portfolios in earlier commentary.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross opening reserves taken from the statement of financial position (claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2021). A gross prior-year movement (movement in prior years' provision) was not explicitly provided in gross terms in a single labelled note for 2021; the report provides a narrative/net breakdown ('The back years, 2018 and prior, contributed GBP 20.6m...') which is a net figure (after reinsurance and other items). Consequently the prior_year_development_gbp_m above uses the reported net prior-year contribution (release) of GBP 20.6m and is flagged as NET/inferred with reduced confidence. Several event impacts quoted in the report are denominated in USD and/or described qualitatively; where no explicit GBP gross amount was available those amounts are set to null. A gross claims development triangle is present in the report but the detailed cell-by-cell extraction was not completed here; users should consult the claims development tables in the notes for a full gross movement reconciliation.
